scripts.dev:desktop:cloud: pnpm exec sdkwork-app dev --runtime-target desktop --deployment-profile cloud
scripts.topology:verify: pnpm topology:validate && pnpm topology:test && node scripts/terminal-dev.mjs --dry-run && node scripts/terminal-dev.mjs --dry-run --deployment-profile cloud
scripts._sdkwork:check: pnpm topology:verify && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm check:app-composition
scripts._sdkwork:verify: pnpm topology:verify && pnpm --filter @sdkwork/terminal-workspace verify && pnpm --filter @sdkwork/terminal-h5 typecheck && pnpm run check:app-composition
scripts._sdkwork:clean: node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => { for (const target of ['apps/sdkwork-terminal-pc/dist', 'apps/sdkwork-terminal-pc/packages/sdkwork-terminal-pc-desktop/dist', 'apps/sdkwork-terminal-pc/packages/sdkwork-terminal-pc-shell/dist', 'apps/sdkwork-terminal-h5/dist']) fs.rmSync(target, { recursive: true, force: true }); })"
scripts.dev:browser:postgres:standalone: pnpm exec sdkwork-app dev --runtime-target browser --deployment-profile standalone
scripts.dev:desktop:postgres:standalone: pnpm exec sdkwork-app dev --runtime-target desktop --deployment-profile standalone
